profile.summary:
Computer Engineer with over 8 years of experience in application development. I have received training in the use of document management tools and have enriched my knowledge of web development frameworks and other programming languages, implementing and executing new solutions. 
In all my work experiences, I have been effective in meeting development targets and highly cooperative when working with team members. I complete clean, error-free designs and support all kinds of projects with my abilities in programming, managing databases and troubleshooting and resolving software problems. Highly knowledgeable in documenting bugs and testing strategies to evaluate new features.
I am always in constant search and learning of new technologies to improve software development practices.

Recently, I embarked on a new journey with DomiDocs, where I have found a dynamic, welcoming environment that encourages me to maximize my professional  skills. I’m excited to contribute optimal solutions with real impact on real estate technology, a field where innovative, high-quality tech solutions are essential.

About DomiDocs®:
DomiDocs® is a Homeowner Enablement Platform® built for the day-to-day operation of residential real estate properties. By combining organization, education and technology we provide the consumers a way to increase the value of their properties, mitigate costly risk and reduce expenses. This is all done with a cloud based digital platform we have built with custom coding from scratch over the last 6 years. Basic functionality includes value and equity tracking, document storage, vendor management, maintenance calendaring, and Machine Learning AI driven recommendation engine. The platform currently supports B2C direct, and B2B2C through the new homebuilder and title verticals.

positions.title: Junior Automotive Technician
positions.description:
• Teamwork and Collaboration
Worked effectively within a team environment to ensure efficient and high-quality service. Coordinated with other technicians and service advisors to optimize workflow and meet customer needs.
• Attention to Detail
Maintained a high standard of accuracy in all tasks, paying close attention to small details that could impact vehicle performance and safety. Ensured that all inspections and repairs met company standards and customer expectations.
• Multipoint Inspection
Conducted comprehensive multipoint inspections on all vehicles, identifying potential issues in key areas such as brakes, battery, fluids, and tire condition. Documented any immediate or future maintenance needs for customer review.
• Service Notes and Documentation
Created detailed service notes and records, accurately documenting all diagnostics, repairs, and parts used. Communicated findings clearly to service advisors and customers to facilitate informed decision-making.
• Brake Inspection and Maintenance
Inspected and diagnosed.Conducted regular checks on brake pads, rotors, and fluid levels, and addressed any wear or damage.
• Battery Check and Maintenance
Tested battery life, voltage, and connections to prevent unexpected vehicle failure. Replaced or serviced batteries as needed to maintain reliable vehicle operation.
• Tire Rotation and Pressure Check
Performed regular tire rotations to promote even tread wear and prolong tire life. Monitored and adjusted tire pressure to improve fuel efficiency, ensure safety, and enhance overall vehicle performance.
• Oil Change and Lubrication
Conducted oil changes to maintain engine health, using the appropriate oil grade for each vehicle. Replaced oil filters and ensured that all fluids were topped off as part of routine vehicle maintenance.
